summary.text: Jaja founded Opobo in 1869 and held the oil markets of the interior with his war canoes and guns, until the British seized him by a trick in 1887.

arms.text: War canoes controlling the creeks to the oil markets.
Guns and cannon bought in trade.

record.text: Jaja broke from Bonny and took much of its trade.
The consul lured Jaja aboard a ship and deported him.

reviewNotes: Arms levels (1 some, 2 a real strength, 3 famous for it) are the compiler’s judgement from the sources, for the Versus page’s guess; please check them.
